editorial: We didn't keep a clean trip-level expense sheet for Turkey, so I won't manufacture a total years later.

The practical takeaway from our trip was that Istanbul gave us plenty of inexpensive everyday food and neighbourhood experiences, while Cappadocia's signature experiences—especially ballooning—were the obvious splurges.

alternatives.title: What if we had a bigger budget?
editorial: We'd spend it on two nights in Cappadocia rather than a fancier Istanbul hotel: one morning to fly, another to watch the balloons from the ground. A well-located cave hotel would be the indulgence.

alternatives.title: What if we had a smaller budget?
editorial: Keep Istanbul as the main event, stay near public transport and treat Cappadocia as the one expensive excursion. The city's best moments—Istiklal after dark, mosque courtyards, bazaars and neighbourhood wandering—don't require luxury spending.
